name: cli-restart-recovery-notice
description: M21 F3 (Wave-2 X-rider): baseline turn, then the registered test reproduces a host death mid-turn (session running, pending inbound with a Processing claim) and drives the REAL boot step `reset_stale_running_sessions` — exactly one recovery notice reaches the wire, a second boot pass and a sweep pass stay quiet, and the re-queued inbound processes normally.
